info.name: Images Guard API
info.description: Requests for the Images Guard API. Set base_url to the API address. For Upload Image, attach one static WebP file in the image form-data field. Copy the returned image_id into the image_id collection variable to poll or delete that image. Upload limits default to 5 MiB, 1920 px on the long side, and 1080 px on the short side; server configuration may lower or raise the byte limit up to 64 MiB.

item.name: Upload Image
item.description: Uploads exactly one static WebP file as multipart form-data field `image`. The API validates the actual bytes, regardless of the filename or claimed media type. Returns 202 Accepted with image_id and a Location header. Error codes: invalid_upload or invalid_image (400), image_too_large or request_too_large (413), unsupported_image (415), invalid_dimensions (422), busy or upload_failed (503).

item.name: Get Image Status
item.description: Polls the image job. Status is pending, processing, completed, or failed. Completed jobs include result; failed jobs include error. Pending and processing jobs return both as null. Responses include Cache-Control: no-store. Error codes: invalid_id (400), not_found (404), database_unavailable (503).

item.name: Delete Image
item.description: Deletes the image record and stored file only when status is completed. Pending, processing, and failed images return 409. Success returns 204 No Content. Error codes: invalid_id (400), not_found (404), not_processed (409), delete_failed (503).

item.name: Liveness
item.description: Checks whether the API process is responding. Returns {"status":"ok"} when healthy.

item.name: Readiness
item.description: Checks PostgreSQL availability; it does not check the model server. Returns {"status":"ok"} when ready, or a not_ready error with status 503.
